newsitem.title: USA: Astra U.S. unit names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Astra U.S. unit names new CEO.

text.p: AB Astra unit Astra USA said it named Ivan Rowley as president and chief executive officer Tuesday, replacing Jan Larsson, who served as head of the pharmaceutical unit since April 29.
Rowley, who assumes his new responsibilities immediately, has held a variety of sales and marketing positions with the company, most recently as vice president of managed care unit Health Alliance.
Larsson will concentrate full-time on his responsibilities as executive vice-president of AB Astra responsible for manufacturing and logistics and as a member of the group executive committee.
Astra USA fired Chief Executive Lars Bildman in late April, accusing him of "improper behavior" after several former employees accused him in lawsuits of sexual harassment.
